documentation.description:
-
  @summary
  Root of the Swiss Micros calculator tools.

  @description
  Empty parent package for the library. All useful declarations live in child units:

  * `Swiss_Micros.Command_Line` — shared GetOpt type for `-d` / `--device`
    and `DM_SERIAL_DEVICE`.
  * `Swiss_Micros.Console_IO` — UART settings, console prompt, and the
    verb strings the calculator understands.

  Marked `Pure` so any tool may `with` it without pulling in elaboration code. Derive a new tool from
  `Command_Line.Object` and speak the verbs in `Console_IO`; do not add declarations here.
